summary: Iteration 30 — Plant of the Week rail. Validated debounced /api/plants/{id} view tracking, /api/plants/of-the-week (incl. ?language=de), /api/plants/popular (default + cap), bot-UA skip, route ordering (not shadowed by /{plant_id}), and the homepage UI integration (eyebrow, image-OG-card src, h2, facts, CTA, views inflection, click-through). All 31 backend tests green (6 new + 13 share-patch regression + 12 iter28 regression).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/plants.py: duplicated docstring comment block above _resolve_plant_for_og (4 identical lines repeated). Cosmetic cleanup.

_record_plant_view swallows ALL exceptions on the dedup insert, not just DuplicateKeyError. A network blip could be misread as a duplicate and silently skip the counter. Catch errors.DuplicateKeyError specifically.

plant_views uses TTL via expires_at (datetime) which is correct; but the _id is plant_id:fp — if fingerprints ever collide across plants this would still be distinct, OK. Just flagging for future thought.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids resolved, click-through OK, OG image src correct)

seed_data_creation: Tests forge fresh X-Forwarded-For + User-Agent per fingerprint; visited tomato/basil/chamomile/borage during runs. No persistent test data — TTL dedup expires in 24h, view_count_7d decays Mondays.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter30 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_plant_of_the_week.py — fingerprint forged via X-Forwarded-For + unique UA per uuid. Be aware: visiting /api/plants/{id} from any new IP+UA increments the 7d counter. Tests use chamomile/borage to avoid clashing with iter28 tomato visits.
